session_read: Pre-open, STABILIZING gate: futures gapping up hard (ES +0.73%, NQ +1.21%) despite a still-hawkish Fed, VIX easing to 18.58. Two open breaches persist: cash ceiling severe (46.09% vs [3,15]%, deliberate hedge) and AI Semis/Fabs + AI Memory/Storage cluster overweights vs a badly underweight Compute/Hyperscaler sleeve.
